mutation.$description: The mutation workbench (MVP): the points show only here. The panel is ToyPanelDialog, its title ToyTitleOnLight, the hint ToyTextMutedOnLight.

card.$description: A mutation card: the mint sticker, 30 px inside (the sketch's 16 px padding with its outline, x 1.5). Its two states are the button's: "can buy" a ToyButtonPrimary (or ToyButtonSecondary), "not enough" the same button disabled (the lilac unplugged face) with the shortfall; the card itself does not change, as on the sketch. The name is ToyPlateTitle, the effect ToyPlateText, the cost number ToyPlateTimer. The hard shadow is the edge form: the right and bottom outlines are 14 px (6 + 8) and reach 8 px outside, as no base layer sits under it in the game.

balance.$description: The points balance at the workbench's top right: a mint plate, flush above and below (the number's line is the plate's height), 27 px at the sides; its text ToyPlateText, the number ToyPlateTimer. The hard shadow is the edge form: the right and bottom outlines are 14 px (6 + 8) and reach 8 px outside, as no base layer sits under it in the game.
